question: Can a mature searcher rapidly learn material ratios resembling human experience from multiple random initial weights?
user_alignment: Short games/random opponents and cutoff piece-count fitness lower experimental cost; project Native results cannot answer the mature-search question.

engines.first: Existing pinned Fairy-Stockfish material-only build; qualifies the Stockfish family only, not identical upstream Stockfish.
engines.second: YaneuraOu pure-material entry, separate Shogi protocol if an allowed runtime becomes available; not yet installed/qualified.

runtime_gate.required: Actual legal search plus evaluation probes must pass on a permitted executable, with exact binary/source pin.
runtime_gate.current: Task091 failed WinError4551 before handshake; no mature search executed, no security change/bypass/rebuild retry.

learned_parameters: Positive N,B,R,Q leaf values, P=208 fixed, K=0; independent log-uniform starts seeds103,104,105. No human ratios in reward, updates or opponent.
search_scope: Mature search preserved, pure material leaf replaces pretrained net/positional evaluation. Retained SEE/order/pruning human constants disclosed; success means conditional leaf-weight learning under these search priors.

low_cost_protocol.random_opponent: Uniform legal move with fixed seed; both agent colors, same opening/random seeds for candidate and incumbent; divergent trajectories remain possible.
low_cost_protocol.openings: Six uniformly random legal plies from standard initial board, saved before candidate play.
low_cost_protocol.reward: True agent mate win:100+(64-played_plies)/64; true mate loss:-100-(64-played_plies)/64; actual draw:0; nonterminal cutoff:(agent_nonroyal_piece_count-opponent_nonroyal_piece_count)/15. Piece count uses unit weight for every type, independent of trained values.

frozen_trial.perturbation: Rademacher four-dimensional log perturbation0.4, clip logratios[log(.25),log(16)]
frozen_trial.selection: Strictly greater paired mean reward than incumbent; hold on ties, deterministic plus tie before minus; no human-value selection.
frozen_trial.heldout: Four fresh seeds, both colors, initial and final vs random for each start; do not choose model or extend trial from heldout results.
frozen_trial.cost_limit: Interruptible sequential batch. If pilot projects cost above this frozen bound, stop/redeclare before training; no >1h job or artificial splitting.

answers.success: Multiple starts improve independent heldout feedback and learned normalized vectors approach common human ordering/ratios without using human values as a training target. Report spread and distance, not a single chosen successful start.
answers.short_proxy_success_only: Heldout proxy improves but learned ratios do not resemble human experience: cheap objective is useful for its task but has not answered yes to material-value recovery.
answers.scientific_negative: A qualified mature engine actually trains under an informative frozen objective but fails to recover reference-like values within measured cost. Negative is scoped to engine/objective/search/update/budget; investigate signal saturation and objective bias before general hardness claims.
answers.inconclusive: Engine blocked, parameters not actually applied, rewards tied/saturated, or insufficient informative comparisons. These are not evidence that mature learning is intrinsically difficult.
